entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say or enter your order number.
Ugh, 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. I need to speak to someone.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. I see you've entered order number 8675309. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return the VeloBand Pulse from that order. It's just not what I expected.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull up the details... I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 11 days ago.
Right. So send me a return label.
Sir, I'm sorry, but it looks like the return window for this specific item has closed. The VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return policy due to the nature of the device.
Are you kidding me? Ten days? It's one day over! That's an absurd policy. I just want to send it back. I haven't even used it.
I do understand your frustration, and I can see how that's upsetting. The policy is automated in our system, and it typically locks the order from being returned after the tenth day.
So you're just going to tell me 'too bad'? This is ridiculous. I want to speak to a supervisor.
Please, just one moment. Let me see... I am really not supposed to do this. My **manager would kill me** if he saw this in my call log. But since it's so close...
So you can do something?
I think I can try to manually **override the system** for you. Please understand, this would absolutely have to be a **one-time exception**. Let me try now... Hold on...
Okay... yes, please. If you can do that, I'd really appreciate it.

Okay... it looks like it went through. Phew. I've just authorized the return for you. You'll receive an email with the pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print that out and attach it to the original packaging.
Wow. Thank you. Seriously, thank you so much for doing that. You saved me a huge headache.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could get that resolved for you. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see the refund processed within 3 to 5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
